trial_court: Family Court Ambikapur, Misc. Criminal Case No. 158/2018
case_name: Deepak Das vs Smt. Dipika Das

parties.respondent_defendant: Smt. Dipika Das, wife and son Vedant Das

facts_of_case: The respondent's wife stopped maintaining her and their child after the husband stopped going to their place. The respondents claimed maintenance of Rs.5,000/- each. The trial court awarded Rs.2,000-2,000/- as maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to prove the execution of the agreement.
legal_principles.held: It is observed that the Ex.D/6 & D/7 which are agreement of marriage and agreement of dissolution of marriage are not admissible because those documents have not been proved by examining the attesting witnesses.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not grant maintenance to a person who has performed second marriage.
legal_principles.held: As per Annexure A/2 i.e. agreement of marriage, non-applicant No.1 has performed second marriage with Immamuddin, who is resident of Raebareli and she is living peacefully with him.

outcome.final_order: The final order was that the applicant's appeal against the trial court's award of maintenance to the respondents was dismissed.
